অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়
অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ
(কাস্টমস ও মূল্য সংযোজন কর)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh acts as the authority issuing the legal notification.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance is the parent government body under which the notification is issued.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division serves as the specific departmental wing responsible for the administration of the customs and value added tax matters addressed in this notification.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19 of this Act serves as the legal basis for the government to issue notifications regarding customs exemptions or amendments in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the necessary legal authority for the government to issue specific fiscal notifications in the public interest.
National Board of Revenue: The board is the designated authority that must be consulted by the government prior to issuing official notifications for customs and taxation amendments.
S.R.O. 236-AIN/2009: This notification is formally amended to update specific H.S. Code classifications referenced in its schedule.
H.S. Code: Several specific commodity codes listed in the table of the existing notification are replaced with updated versions to ensure current alignment with the customs tariff classification.
TABLE-1: The table within the notification is updated to replace obsolete H.S. Codes with revised classifications for various imported items.
